description: This file defines the 'Login' controller class within the Opencart admin module, handling login page display and authentication logic, including session management, token validation, and redirection.

classes.name: Login
classes.description: Controller class handling admin login page display and login process including authentication and session management.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the login page, manages session tokens and redirection if already logged in, and prepares data for the login view.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Handles login form submission, validates tokens, authenticates user credentials, manages session tokens, logs login activity, and handles redirection or error responses.
